source: IBM Debater ArgKP v1 (Bar-Haim et al., ACL 2020), folder kpm_data/ of https://github.com/IBM/KPA_2021_shared_task

topics_left_out.We should close Guantanamo Bay detention: possibly sensitive (a named conflict, detention): left out to be safe
topics_left_out.We should abandon marriage: possibly sensitive (sexuality and gender): left out to be safe

rule: an argument is kept if it matches exactly one key point (label 1: at least 60% of 8 annotators) and has label 0 (at most 15%) for every other key point of its topic and stance; that key point is its cluster

changes: records.csv is a modified version of the ArgKP data (Enhanced Data under CDLA-Sharing-1.0), made by harness/scripts/convert_argkp.py: 17 of the 28 topics kept; only arguments that match exactly one key point with no undecided pair kept; each argument joined with its key point; whitespace normalized; new ids; word counts and a similarity key added.
